root_cause_confirmation.mechanism: PyInstaller's bindepend scanned host PATH during Qt6Core analysis and harvested alien ICU78 from external native toolchain (C:\Users\49745\.cache\codex-runtimes\codex-primary-runtime\dependencies\native\poppler\Library\bin\icuuc.dll), copying it to _internal/icuuc.dll. Windows loader resolved _internal/icuuc.dll ahead of C:\Windows\System32\icuuc.dll. The alien ICU78 exported only _78-suffixed symbols, lacking the 20 unsuffixed symbols (ucnv_*) demanded by Qt6Core.dll, causing WinError 127 and PySide6.QtGui ImportError.

entries_icu_consumer_analysis.binary_dependencies: Python stdlib + in-repo packages only; 0 external C-extensions
entries_icu_consumer_analysis.evidence: Static import graph scan + binary PE import table scan (0 icu imports)
PE import table scan of all bundled ML binaries (torch, torchvision, doctr, transformers, onnxruntime, DirectML.dll) shows 0 references to icu*.dll
Qt6Core.dll imports 20 unsuffixed ICU symbols (ucnv_*) supplied by Windows System32 icuuc.dll; it does NOT consume ICU78. Bundling alien ICU78 broke it via shadowing.
